verdict.rationale: Raygun's AI Resolution feature only integrates directly with OpenAI/Azure OpenAI APIs (docs-27, docs-30, docs-32) — there is no evidence Raygun itself can consume external MCP servers' tools. The only MCP-related evidence (raygun-probe-3) shows Raygun being exposed AS an MCP server for other agents to call, which is the reverse of this story's client-side capability.
